lines: General Sargas Ruk's dialogue.
- Cressa Tal! No betrayal burns deeper than yours. No Grineer is more deserving of hate.

path: When Returning to Strata Relay After Completing Reconstruction Tasks
lines: - Cressa Tal, I gave you everything: a command, soldiers eager to kill and die. All the glory a leader could ever want! And instead, you chose to stand with rats.
- You rejected your destiny! There is no other path. Only failure and death. It is all going to burn, Cressa. First the relay. Then, Steel Meridian. Then, you.
- Rat, I will boil your metal flesh til [sic] you become a puddle of molten fire.
- All your planning. All your work. Up in flames.
- Generic rejects, Orokin freaks. Defeating me will not change who you are.
- Death is a figment. Only pain is real.
CODEX
Vay Hek,

Releasing the Grustrag Three? Tell me this rumor is a lie. Tell me you have not forgotten what those defects cost me. Traitors must be eradicated but you think they can be rehabilitated? Arrogance. If it was up to me, Grustrag and everything in it would be ash. No Doctor can cure disloyalty.
The responsibility for this mistake is yours alone. Trust me, you will bleed regret.
Ruk
